decisions.reason: Building on the established offer and aligned with the firm's direction, its results likely meet aspirations and slack permits continued support.
An incremental carrier wafer close to the core, its satisfactory performance against prior performance makes search and dropping unnecessary.
As a flagship product with strategic importance and industry growth, management keeps it despite some uncertainty because slack allows carrying it.
Close to the established offer and presented as a focus, it likely meets aspirations with low risk, so there is no reason to drop it.
Distant from the established offer and with no evidence of meeting aspirations, a likely shortfall triggers problemistic search and resource release.
